title: Stage a tote exchange based on tote fullness thresholds (imminently full/completely full)
summary: Use the source-described tote fullness thresholds to determine whether an exchange staging situation is aligned with the intended exchange concept: one AGV moves out while another moves in simultaneously. The source states that exchange staging can happen when a tote is immediately full or completely full (described as imminently full/completely full).
when_to_use: Use when you are observing a tote exchange staging situation and need to decide whether the tote’s fullness state matches the source-described exchange staging condition (immediately full / completely full, described as imminently full/completely full).
not_for: Do not use this procedure to determine exact tote fullness percentages or to set/override exchange thresholds; the packet does not provide live UI fields, percentage cutoffs, or how to read them on the live system.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Observe the tote involved in the exchange and determine whether it is described/represented as immediately full or completely full (imminently full/completely full), then confirm the exchange concept is being used (simultaneous move out/move in).

access_or_tools_needed: Access to the live system view where tote fullness/state can be observed (as applicable at the site)

access_required: Live system view where tote fullness/state can be observed (as applicable at the site)
system_preconditions: An exchange staging situation is occurring (one AGV moving out while another moves in simultaneously).

visual_references.description: Training video frame showing the exchange concept and the stated staging condition: thresholds where staging for an exchange can happen when a tote is immediately full or completely full (imminently filled).

steps.title: Identify the tote involved in the exchange and determine whether it is described as immediately full or completely full (imminently full/completely full)
steps.purpose: Establish whether the tote meets the source-described condition for exchange staging.
steps.instruction: On the live system view you use at your site, locate the tote involved in the exchange and determine whether its fullness/state is described as immediately full or completely full (imminently full/completely full).
steps.expected_result: You can state whether the tote meets the source-described staging condition: immediately full or completely full (imminently filled).
steps.healthy_condition: The tote involved in the exchange is represented/understood as immediately full or completely full (imminently filled).
steps.failure_condition: The tote is not represented/understood as immediately full or completely full (imminently filled).

actions.label: Check tote fullness/state against staging condition
actions.exact_action: Identify the tote involved in the exchange and determine whether it is described as immediately full or completely full (imminently full/completely full).

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot determine whether the tote is immediately full or completely full from the live view, request support/clarification.

source_evidence.quote: “So staging for an exchange can happen when a tote is immediately full or completely full, eminently filled.”

steps.title: Confirm the exchange concept is being used to achieve simultaneous movement (one AGV moves out while another moves in)
steps.purpose: Verify the exchange staging behavior matches the source-described exchange concept.
steps.instruction: Observe the exchange staging behavior in the live system and confirm it is operating as described: one AGV moves out while another moves in simultaneously together.
steps.expected_result: You confirm the exchange concept is being used for simultaneous movement: one AGV moves out while another moves in.
steps.healthy_condition: The exchange staging shows simultaneous movement consistent with the source concept (one moves out, one moves in).
steps.failure_condition: The observed behavior does not match the simultaneous move out/move in exchange concept.

actions.label: Verify simultaneous move out/move in
actions.exact_action: Confirm that the exchange concept is being used to achieve simultaneous movement: one AGV moves out while another moves in.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the exchange staging behavior does not show simultaneous move out/move in, request support/clarification.

source_evidence.quote: “The goal is to have one AGV come behind it and then move simultaneously together. One moves out, one moves in.”

steps.title: If the tote is not at the described fullness threshold, do not assume exchange staging is intended by the source concept
steps.purpose: Prevent misclassification of the exchange staging intent when the tote fullness condition is not met.
steps.instruction: If the tote involved is not described as immediately full or completely full (imminently full/completely full), treat the exchange staging as not aligned with the source-described exchange staging concept and request support/clarification.
steps.expected_result: You treat the situation as not aligned with the source-described staging condition when the tote fullness does not match immediately full/completely full (imminently filled).
steps.healthy_condition: The tote fullness condition matches the source-described staging condition; otherwise you do not assume staging intent and you escalate for clarification.
steps.failure_condition: You assume exchange staging intent even though the tote fullness condition does not match immediately full/completely full (imminently filled).

actions.label: Request support/clarification when thresholds do not match
actions.exact_action: If the tote is not at the described fullness threshold, do not assume exchange staging is intended by the source concept.

stop_or_escalate_if: If tote fullness does not match the source-described thresholds, request support/clarification.

source_evidence.quote: “So staging for an exchange can happen when a tote is immediately full or completely full, eminently filled.”

success_criteria: Operator can determine whether the tote involved is immediately full or completely full (imminently full/completely full) per the source-described staging condition.
Operator confirms the exchange concept is being used for simultaneous movement (one AGV moves out while another moves in).
If the tote fullness condition does not match, operator does not assume staging intent and requests support/clarification.
healthy_conditions: Tote involved is described/represented as immediately full or completely full (imminently filled).
Exchange staging shows simultaneous movement: one AGV moves out while another moves in.
failure_conditions: Tote involved is not described/represented as immediately full or completely full (imminently filled), but exchange staging is assumed to be intended per the source concept.
Observed exchange staging does not show simultaneous move out/move in behavior.
escalation_guidance: If tote fullness does not match the source-described thresholds (immediately full/completely full, imminently filled), request support/clarification.
